itinerary.text:
Arrival in Da Nang
Arrive in Da Nang and transfer to the hotel by private vehicle.

Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge
After breakfast, proceed for a Full-Day Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge Tour, including Cable Car and Indian Lunch, on a private basis.

Marble Mountain – Coconut Forest – Hoi An
After breakfast, enjoy an afternoon tour covering Marble Mountain, Coconut Forest and Hoi An Ancient Town, including a boat ride and lantern release, on a private basis.

Da Nang – Hanoi – Sapa
After breakfast, transfer to Da Nang Airport for your flight to Hanoi. Upon arrival, transfer to Sapa by private vehicle. In the afternoon, visit Cat Cat Village on a private basis.

Sapa – Fansipan Tour
After breakfast, proceed for the Fansipan Tour with Cable Car and Monorail. Private transfers included; no guide.

Sapa – Hanoi
After breakfast, check out and transfer from Sapa Hotel to Hanoi Hotel by private vehicle.

Hanoi City Tour
After breakfast, proceed for a Full-Day Hanoi City Tour with local lunch on a private basis.

Hanoi – Ha Long Bay Cruise
After breakfast, proceed to Ha Long Bay and board the cruise. Enjoy the cruise experience with Full Board Meals. Overnight stay on the Ha Long Bay Cruise.

Ha Long Bay – Departure
Enjoy brunch on the cruise and check out at approximately 12:30 PM. Transfer from Ha Long Bay to the airport for your flight back to your home country.
